review_candidates.title: Oracle Consulting – HCM Fusion Consultant - Contractor for Pharos team
review_candidates.description: Job Description He should be able to operate independently to provide quality work products to an engagement, to perform complex duties and tasks that need independent judgment, in order to implement Oracle products and technology to meet customer needs. He should have experiences and be able to apply Oracle methodology, company procedures, and leading practices. Ability and experiences on acting as the team lead on projects will be seriously taken into consideration. The successful candidate should be able to conduct C-Level communication, effective communication with management of customer organizations. The candidate should also demonstrate proven expertise to deliver functional and technical solutions on moderately complex customer engagements.
